# Core-hours

*Generated by Claude.*

Core-hours charged to MESAWAVE jobs, by project code, to 2026-11-17. NCGD0039 is for the expensive runs,
and each use needs the project lead's explicit OK; small tests go on NCGD0011.

| Project code | Derecho | Casper | Total | What |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| NCGD0011 | 137 | 73 | 210 | CDEPS tests, A cases, regional WW3 and ice tests, the wu2r05 global test (2026-10-16 to 11-17) |
| NCGD0039 | 6,322 | 0 | 6,322 | wu025r005 smoke runs (3,652), the wu025r004 check (2,571), mesh builds and staging (98) (2026-11-13 to 11-17) |

For scale: the proposal budgets 96 million core-hours for the production runs (873 simulated years at
110,000 each, its Table 2).

**Held:** job 8215539 (`era5uw_ww3_wu025r005`, 24 days on 16 nodes, NCGD0039, up to 8,192 core-hours),
held on 2026-11-17 until it is approved.

**How the numbers are made.** `code/claude/core_hours.py` sums the PBS accounting records (`qhist`, the
command is in the script) and picks MESAWAVE jobs by name. Derecho's main queue charges whole nodes
(nodes × 128 × hours); its develop queue and Casper charge the cores used. All jobs so far ran at
regular priority (no multiplier). Update the table after each run.
